name: smwmusic-radix-confusion
title: Radix - Confusion
description:
A long and abstract/space-ish song composed by Radix.

Note: not compatible with Bonus End, Thunder/Blarggs, Yoshi and P-Switch. I suggest to use the optimized version, as the other one, for having a bit of echo, is not compatible with other stuff like Stage Clear and Starman.
